ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Primary text, heading fills, primary borders, and the structural ink color across all UI surfaces

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Default page canvas, card surfaces, button text on dark fills, and outlined-button fills

carbon.$description: Carbon — Filled primary action background, hard offset shadow color, and high-contrast icon fills

cream-paper.$description: Cream Paper — Warm hero band, footer surface, and the signature alternate canvas that gives Coda its editorial mood

ash-border.$description: Ash Border — Hairline borders, card edges, and subtle dividers separating surfaces from canvas

graphite.$description: Graphite — Secondary body text, muted helper text, and low-emphasis metadata

smoke.$description: Smoke — Tertiary text, placeholder text, disabled labels, and nav item resting state

slate-button.$description: Slate Button — Secondary button borders and mid-weight icon strokes

ember-orange.$description: Ember Orange — Sole chromatic accent — heading highlights, section eyebrow text, decorative underlines, and brand-mark punctuation. The single warm note against an otherwise black-and-cream system

calibre-r.$description: Display and section headlines. Custom geometric 700-weight face with extremely tight tracking that compresses letterforms into dense blocks of ink. The heavy + tight combination is Coda's signature — headlines feel carved rather than written. Substitute: Manrope 800 or DM Sans 800 with -0.03em tracking.

inter.$description: All UI text: body copy, nav links, buttons, labels, captions. Inter carries the entire functional layer; its near-default weights and tracking let the Calibre headlines lead.

tiempos-headline.$description: Occasional editorial subheading in a light serif weight — the soft counterpoint to Calibre's blocky display. Used sparingly for emphasis rather than hierarchy.
